predictions.rationale: Central domain entity that represents an order, contains logic for creation, status transitions (stock confirmed, paid, shipped, cancelled) and therefore underpins the entire process.
Enumeration/value object defining the various order statuses (awaiting validation, stock confirmed, paid, shipped, cancelled) used throughout the workflow.
Application-layer handler that executes the creation of an order at checkout, kicking off the lifecycle tracked by subsequent status changes.
Command definition that models the intent to create a new order; directly linked to checkout initiation of the process.
Handles transition to ‘stock confirmed’ status, a key milestone tracked in the feature description.
Updates an order to the ‘paid’ status after successful payment, matching the payment tracking aspect.
Responsible for moving an order to the ‘shipped’ state, covering the shipment tracking phase.
Implements order cancellation logic, addressing the requirement to cancel orders.
Domain event handler that reacts to stock confirmation, propagating the status change through the system.
Domain event handler for the transition to ‘paid’, ensuring the system responds appropriately to payment completion.
